module.name: roksbnkctl-cwc-guard
module.description: Clears F5's f5-spk-cwc ReadWriteOnce Multi-Attach deadlock so BNK licensing can activate. For EXISTING clusters only — the deadlock arises when a cluster that has already run BNK recycles the cwc pod under a RollingUpdate, so a freshly created cluster cannot hit it and should not include this module. Runs alongside the BNK install; harmless once F5 ships the fix.

optional.name: cwc_deployment
optional.label: CWC deployment
optional.description: Deployment whose RWO PVC deadlocks on a RollingUpdate.

optional.name: cwc_selector
optional.label: CWC pod selector
optional.description: Selector used to wait for the old pod to detach the volume.
